She gains attack speed and movement speed, and her attacks splash physical damage around her target. Snack Attack empowers her next attack during the frenzy with bonus physical damage based on the target's missing health and healing for Briar.
text.counterplay: Create distance during her pursuit, spread away from her target, and respect the bite when wounded.

text.answer: Chilling Scream ends Briar's frenzy and charges a scream while healing her and reducing incoming damage; crowd control cannot interrupt the charge. The scream deals magic damage and slows enemies. A full charge also knocks enemies back, with extra magic damage and a stun if they collide with terrain.
text.counterplay: Move out of the scream's path and away from walls; avoid committing damage into her charge.

text.answer: Certain Death fires a long-range projectile that marks and reveals the first enemy champion hit, then sends Briar dashing to them. Her arrival deals magic damage around the target and fears nearby enemies other than her prey. She enters an empowered frenzy focused on her prey, gaining armor, magic resistance, life steal, and extra movement speed; it lasts until she or her prey dies, unless ended early with Chilling Scream.
text.counterplay: Dodge the projectile and spread away from marked allies to limit her arrival's impact.
